1. (Currently amended) A method for content optimization, comprising: receiving a rule on probability factor, the rule on probability factor specifying a statistical probability that a piece of content expresses a particular value of a selected content attribute; generating a plurality of pieces of content in accordance with the rule on probability factor __wherein each piece of content is generated with a distinct variation of the selected content attribute__; collecting content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content when the plurality of pieces of content are in use __by measuring user engagement metrics specific to each distinct variation__; determining, by a processor, an aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute having the particular value based on the content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content __by computing statistical measures of the user engagement metrics for each distinct variation__; and modifying, by the processor, the rule on probability factor based on the aggregated performance data __by adjusting the probability weights assigned to each distinct variation based on the statistical measures__.

2. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, wherein the selected content attribute is an attribute of a content element, an attribute of a relationship, an attribute of a size or position adjustment, or an attribute of a transition __and wherein each content attribute variation is independently measurable and trackable__.

5. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising: determining, by the processor, a deviation value for the aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute based on the content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content __by calculating a statistical variance or standard deviation of the user engagement metrics__, wherein the modifying step comprises modifying the rule on probability factor based on both the aggregated performance data and the deviation value for the aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute __by weighting the probability adjustments according to the statistical confidence level derived from the deviation value__.

6. (Currently amended) The method of claim 1, further comprising: receiving a set of rules for content generation __that define which content attributes are eligible for probabilistic variation__; identifying a changeable content attribute based on the set of rules for content generation __by determining which attributes are designated as variable rather than fixed__; and composing, by the processor, one or more rules on probability factor for the changeable content attribute __by establishing initial probability distributions for each identified changeable attribute__.

8. (Currently amended) A content optimization system, comprising: a rule management module maintaining a set of rules for content generation, the set of rules comprising a rule on probability factor, the rule on probability factor specifying a statistical probability that a piece of content expresses a particular value of a selected content attribute __wherein the rule management module stores and updates probability weights for distinct variations of the selected content attribute__; a content generation module operative to generate a plurality of pieces of content based on the set of rules __by creating content instances with different values of the selected content attribute according to the probability weights__, the plurality of pieces of content designed with a particular optimization objective; and a content evaluation module operative to evaluate content performance on reaching the particular optimization objective based on data acquired when the plurality of pieces of content are displayed __by collecting and analyzing user engagement metrics for each content instance__, wherein the content evaluation module is further operative to determine an aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute having the particular value based on the evaluated content performance __by computing statistical summaries of the user engagement metrics for each attribute value__, wherein the rule management module is operative to amend the rule on probability factor based on the aggregated content performance data __by recalibrating the probability weights to favor attribute values associated with higher performance metrics__.

9. (Currently amended) The system of claim 8, wherein the selected content attribute is an attribute of a content element, an attribute of a relationship, an attribute of a metric adjustment, or an attribute of a transition __and wherein variations in each selected content attribute are independently generated and independently measured__.

10. (Currently amended) The system of claim 8, wherein the content evaluation module is further operative to determine a deviation value for the aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute based on the content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content __by calculating statistical variance or confidence intervals for the performance metrics__, and wherein the rule management module is further operative to modify the rule on probability factor based on both the aggregated performance data and the deviation value for the aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute __by adjusting probability weights with consideration for the statistical reliability of the measured performance data__.

11. (Currently amended) The system of claim 8, wherein the rule management module is further operative to identify a changeable content attribute based on the set of rules for content generation __by determining which attributes are designated as variable__ and compose a rule on probability factor for the changeable content attribute __by establishing an initial probability distribution for the identified changeable attribute__.

13. (Currently amended) A method comprising: receiving a first rule on probability factor and a second rule on probability factor, the first rule on probability factor defining a statistical probability that a piece of content expresses a first value of a selected content attribute, the second rule on probability factor defining a statistical probability that a piece of content expresses a second value of the selected content attribute, the second value being different from the first value __wherein the first and second rules together define a complete probability distribution for the selected content attribute__; generating a plurality of pieces of content in accordance with the first rule on probability factor and the second rule on probability factor __by creating content instances with the first value and second value according to their respective probability weights__; collecting content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content when the plurality of pieces of content are in use __by measuring user engagement metrics for each content instance__; determining, by a processor, a first aggregated performance data for the first value of the selected content attribute based on the content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content __by computing statistical measures of user engagement for content instances with the first value__; determining, by the processor, a second aggregated performance data for the second value of the selected content attribute based on the content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content __by computing statistical measures of user engagement for content instances with the second value__; and modifying, by the processor, the first rule on probability factor and the second rule on probability factor based on both the first aggregated performance data and the second aggregated performance data __by adjusting the probability weights to reflect the comparative performance of the first and second values__.

14. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, wherein the selected content attribute is an attribute of a content element, an attribute of a relationship, an attribute of a metric adjustment, or an attribute of a transition __and wherein the first and second values of the selected content attribute are independently measurable and trackable__.

15. (Currently amended) The method of claim 13, further comprising: determining, by the processor, a deviation value for the first aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute based on the content performance data of the plurality of pieces of content __by calculating statistical variance or confidence intervals for the first value's performance metrics__, wherein the modifying step comprises modifying the first rule on probability factor based on both the first aggregated performance data and the deviation value for the first aggregated performance data for the selected content attribute __by adjusting the first rule's probability weight with consideration for the statistical reliability of the measured performance data__.
